text:
anna: Quick heads up — Dependabot flagged CVE-2024-9154 in tokenizers wheel during our scheduled lockfile regen.
marcus: Link to the failing job?
anna: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/3892 - macos-latest builder failing on wheel build.
anna: ```
ERROR: Could not build wheels for tokenizers
  Building wheel for tokenizers (pyproject.toml) ... error
  error: Rust toolchain not found: need rustc >=1.58
```
lee: Repro'd locally in a macos container; pip can't build from source due to rust toolchain mismatch and our mac runners don't cache manylinux wheels.
sophie: Does this affect Private/on-prem images or any KMS integrations?
anna: Not KMS directly. Private images that build wheels at image-build time will be affected; hosted inference is fine because we use prebuilt wheels in most regions, but SDK builds fail.
marcus: Proposal: surgical lock update + backport. Steps: 1) pin tokenizers to 0.12.x on the stable/2.x branch in pyproject.toml; 2) run `poetry lock --no-update` on that branch; 3) run full test matrix (macos/linux/python3.9-3.11); 4) open hotpatch PR and backport as needed.
lee: Also try building an internal binary wheel and publish to our wheelhouse (artifactory) as short-term mitigation. Repro command: `pip wheel --no-binary :all: tokenizers` shows the rust failure locally.
infra-bot: CI rerun triggered by @marcus for job 3892 (queued).
sophie: I'll take ownership of the hotpatch PR and run macOS runners. ETA ~4h.
marcus: If we can't rely on a prebuilt wheel upstream, fallback plan is: pin to last-good upstream wheel + push internal wheel; then schedule upstream follow-up with tokenizers maintainers.
anna: Decision needed on whether to backport to v1.x maintained branch (some customers still on it). Impact: only inference-serving image builds and python SDK packaging.
lee: Low-effort improvement: validate wheel build on macos in the release pipeline so regressions show up earlier.
sophie: I'll add a quick macos wheel-build smoke to the patch.
marcus: Opening PRs now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-inference/pull/3501 (hotpatch), https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/112 (sdk pin).
sophie: After green we'll canary the SDK release and notify product + support.
anna: tagging @security-incident and @eng-oncall for visibility.
marcus: If someone needs help with the lockfile commands, run: `git checkout stable/2.x && poetry add tokenizers@0.12.4 --lock` then push branch.
sophie: Got it — starting tests. :thumbsup:
